## Notes

- Focus areas selected: HAL target UAT, real Codex app-server launch gate, deterministic failure fixtures, workspace-scoped flags, marker-scoped disposable fixture, deployment preconditions, descriptor-only UAT evidence, PR packet traceability, service/gateway health, and zero-residue cleanup proof.
- Depth level: Formal release/UAT gate.
- Actor/timing: Reviewer and operator during Phase 4 UAT/deployment readiness.
- Explicit must-have items incorporated: real `codex app-server` handshake/thread/turn launch; deterministic fixtures only on shared parser/failure/lifecycle/timeout/artifact-redaction paths; workspace-scoped flags; marker-scoped fixture; app-server unavailable blocks completion; redacted descriptor-level `uat-report.md`; PR review packet traceability; service/gateway health where applicable; cleanup proof for DB rows, sandbox directories, and artifact residue.
